flight_tickets.title: Domestic & International Flight Tickets
flight_tickets.short_desc: Fast, hassle-free booking for worldwide and local flights with optimal schedules and competitive fares.
flight_tickets.long_desc: We provide end-to-end flight ticketing services covering both domestic routes and major international destinations. Our specialists assist with flight search, real-time fare comparison, seat selection, extra baggage requests, and flexible rebooking options.
flight_tickets.p1_desc: Instant ticketing across all local airlines with preferred seat selection and luggage add-ons.
flight_tickets.p2_desc: Comprehensive international routing, transit advisory, and priority cabin bookings across global carriers.

hotel_reservations.title: Hotel Reservations
hotel_reservations.short_desc: Verified hotel bookings and accommodation arrangements in prime destinations worldwide.
hotel_reservations.long_desc: Secure quality stays tailored to your budget and travel purpose. From luxury city-center hotels and boutique resorts to budget-friendly apartments, we handle reservations in major tourist and business hubs with transparent booking policies.
hotel_reservations.p1_desc: Centrally located 3-star and 4-star property bookings ideal for city exploration and short stays.
hotel_reservations.p2_desc: Exclusive 5-star hotel and resort bookings featuring complimentary breakfast, airport shuttles, and VIP amenities.

travel_services.title: Other Travel Services
travel_services.short_desc: Comprehensive travel management including insurance, airport transfers, and customized itineraries.
travel_services.long_desc: Our agency provides complete support services to ensure every aspect of your journey is seamless. We handle travel insurance issuance, private ground transfers, guided city tours, and administrative visa processing support.
travel_services.p1_desc: Medical coverage, lost baggage protection, and flight delay compensation policies.
travel_services.p2_desc: Reliable private driver pickups and drop-offs between airports, hotels, and event venues.

umrah_packages.title: Umrah Visa & Packages
umrah_packages.short_desc: Spiritual Umrah journeys with complete visa support, close Haram accommodations, and guided ziyarat.
umrah_packages.long_desc: Experience a fulfilling pilgrimage to the Holy Cities of Makkah and Madinah. We provide complete Umrah visa processing, flights, comfortable hotels walking distance from Al-Masjid an-Nabawi and Masjid al-Haram, conditioned transport, and historical ziyarat tours.
umrah_packages.f2: Hotels within Walking Distance to Haram
umrah_packages.f4: Guided Religious Ziyarat in Makkah & Madinah
umrah_packages.p1_desc: Complete 2-week spiritual package including visa issuance, hotel bookings close to the Holy Mosques, and bus transfers.
umrah_packages.p2_desc: Balanced 3-week itinerary allowing extended worship time in both Holy Cities with guided historical site visits.
umrah_packages.p3_desc: Comprehensive month-long pilgrimage package offering full accommodation, flight ticketing, and dedicated ground support.

student_visas.title: Student Visas
student_visas.short_desc: Complete admission guidance, visa processing, and university matching for Turkey and China.
student_visas.long_desc: Achieve your international study goals with dedicated educational consultancy. We specialize in Turkey and China student visa processing, university admission applications, scholarship guidance, and document verification for recognized higher institutions.
student_visas.p1_desc: End-to-end guidance for Turkish university admissions, YÖK equivalency documentation, and embassy visa appointments.
student_visas.p2_desc: Complete processing for Chinese universities, JW201/JW202 form clearance, and student visa application.
